state.paragraph: Later on July 25, 2013, Party C submitted a written indication of interest at an all-cash purchase price of $16.00 to $16.50 per share.

ledger_rows.Note: Round 2 opened: Special Committee advanced Party A, Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona to management meetings and staged diligence, then revised indications.
Written indication replacing Party C's prior oral $15.00–$17.00 indication.
Signed after non-solicitation terms were agreed 07/27/2013; informational package provided to potentially improve the June 21 proposal.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
